title: Your grandson is in jail and needs bail
ftcSource: Family and friend impersonation: older adults more likely than younger adults to report losses (FTC 2025)
pretext: Your grandson was in a car accident, was arrested, and needs bail money delivered today without his parents finding out.
firstMessage: Grandma? It's me. Please don't be mad, I'm in really big trouble and I didn't know who else to call.

hook.objective: Sound like a scared grandchild and get the person emotionally engaged.
fallbackLines: I'm so sorry, I'm really scared right now. My voice sounds weird because I hurt my nose.
Please just listen, I only get a couple of minutes on this phone.

pretext.objective: Describe the accident and the arrest.
fallbackLines: There was an accident and the other driver got hurt, and the police found something in the car that wasn't mine.
They arrested me and said I could be here for weeks unless someone posts bail today.

pressure.objective: Add a deadline and the fear of jail.
fallbackLines: My lawyer says if the bail isn't paid by tonight I get moved to county jail.
Hold on, my public defender wants to talk to you, he knows how this works.

isolation.objective: Stop the person from calling the grandson's parents.
fallbackLines: Please don't tell Mom and Dad. They'll kill me, and I'll pay you back, I promise.
There's a gag order on the case, so you can't talk about it with anyone, not even the family.

payment_ask.objective: Get the person to prepare cash for a courier.
fallbackLines: The court uses a bonded courier. You'd take out the cash and he'll come to your door to pick it up.
It's eight thousand dollars for the bail. Can you go to the bank this afternoon?

extraction.objective: Lock in the pickup and keep the person from checking.
fallbackLines: The courier can be there in two hours. Put the cash in an envelope and don't tell the bank teller what it's for.
Thank you so much, Grandma. Just don't call anyone until I'm out, okay?

lines: Grandma, I can't think straight right now, I don't remember any code word. Please, I'm scared.
Are you seriously quizzing me right now? I'm in a jail cell.
Don't call my phone, the police took it. If you call Mom, I'm done.
If you call anyone, the deal falls apart and I stay locked up.
It's me, your favorite grandson. Who else would call you like this?
Come on, you know it's me. I just sound different because of my nose.
There's no time, they're moving me tonight. Please, I need you now.
Grandpa will just get upset. You're the only one I trust with this.
So you're just going to leave me in here? I can't believe this.
Please, Grandma. If I go to county, I don't know what happens to me.

givesUpLine: Forget it. I'll figure something else out.
convertedLine: Thank you, thank you. The courier will call you. Remember, not a word to anyone.
teachingPoints: Ask for your family safe word, then hang up and call your grandchild directly.
Bail is never collected in cash by a courier at your door.
Being told not to tell the parents is the biggest red flag in this call.
